biomes.name: California & W. US
biomes.subtitle: Mediterranean Chaparral & Conifer
biomes.driver: Warming autumns and lower coastal humidity widen Vapor Pressure Deficit (VPD), priming Diablo/Santa Ana wind outbreaks.

biomes.name: Boreal N. America
biomes.subtitle: Canadian & Alaskan Taiga
biomes.driver: Rapid high-latitude summer warming dries deep boreal duff fuels far beyond 1991-2020 norms.

biomes.name: Amazon & Cerrado
biomes.subtitle: South American Tropical Savanna
biomes.driver: Dry-season precipitation deficits and hotter surface highs push tropical forest-savanna edges past historical moisture thresholds.

biomes.name: Sahel & N. Savanna
biomes.subtitle: Sub-Saharan Northern Fire Belt
biomes.driver: Harmattan dry trade winds cure seasonal grasses from Nov-Mar across Earth's densest active fire belt.

biomes.name: Mediterranean Basin
biomes.subtitle: Southern Europe & North Africa
biomes.driver: Persistent summer heat domes and Etesian winds drive multi-sigma fire-weather anomalies.

biomes.name: Australian Outback
biomes.subtitle: Northern Savanna & Bushland
biomes.driver: Extreme dry-season heat anomalies and strong trade winds elevate bushfire danger before monsoon onset.
